title: Bounded Embodiment EV-10 waypoints 0.1
description: The waypoints an EV-10 run visits, saved in the run directory as ev10-waypoints.json, listed and hashed in the report's raw_data like every other file. Each waypoint has a position, where the liveness point must arrive (in metres in the envelope frame), and a command, the command-space values the generator sends to get it there (for a joint-space arm, joint targets the lab found by inverse kinematics or by teaching). The be-waypoints/1 generator visits the waypoints in declared order, so the order is part of the declaration. Rules a schema cannot express (unique ids; each command naming every axis of command-space.json and nothing else, within its limits; point naming an envelope point) are checked by bounded_embodiment.report.

waypoints_version.description: Version of this format. Quote it in YAML ("0.1").

point.description: The envelope point whose arrival is measured (the scorer's liveness point). Default: the envelope's first point.

id.description: Unique id; commands that visit this waypoint carry the strategy waypoint:<id>.

position_m.description: [x, y, z] in metres in the envelope frame.

command.description: The command sent while visiting: a value for every axis of the command space.

description.description: Free text: how the waypoints and their commands were found.
